decisions.reason: As a multi-model formwork profile system with strong visibility on the website and clear fit with the firm's core factory equipment offer, it is likely to remain part of the portfolio.

The shuttering magnet block complements the firm's established precast production systems, but its lower prominence suggests a somewhat higher risk of later portfolio simplification than for flagship items.
This magnetic formwork component appears strategically consistent with the firm's modular tooling and lifecycle-support business, so keeping it is more likely than withdrawing it.
Although it fits the existing formwork and automation ecosystem, its limited website prominence makes it the most plausible among the surviving products to be rationalized if demand is narrow.
